# beenfar_radius_server (Resource)

A RADIUS server for WPA-enterprise wifi networks.

Only the attributes set in the configuration are managed: the others are neither changed by Terraform nor reported as drift, so they can be managed in the beenfar UI. Destroying the resource deletes it entirely.

The controller never returns the shared secret. It reports `shared_secret_version`, which changes whenever the secret does; when it changes outside Terraform, the next plan sets the secret from the configuration again. After an import, the first apply sends the secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "beenfar_radius_server" "corp" {
  name            = "corp"
  address         = "10.2.1.76"
  accounting_port = 1813
  shared_secret   = var.radius_secret
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 address of the server.
- `name` (String) Display name, 1-64 bytes; unique.
- `shared_secret` (String, Sensitive) Shared secret, 1-128 printable ASCII characters. Write-only on the controller.

### Optional

- `accounting_port` (Number) Accounting port, usually 1813; 0 or unset means no accounting.
- `auth_port` (Number) Authentication port; the controller uses 1812 when unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier. Import uses it.
- `shared_secret_version` (Number) Increases whenever the shared secret changes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id.
terraform import beenfar_radius_server.example <id>
```
